text:
Sugar beet failed across the Tavrin Valley this season, the Tavrin Valley Agricultural Board confirmed on 14 October 2024.

I was at the press briefing in Karsholm, where Dr. Marek Oslavin, the Board's Chief Agronomist, presented the Autumn Harvest Assessment Report (TVAB-24/09). Yields fell 62 percent below the five-year average, he told the room, with about 18,400 hectares affected.

Copies of the report were handed out at the door. I read the summary on the spot, and it names sugar beet as the crop that failed this season.

Dr. Oslavin spoke plainly about the scale of the loss. The figures, he said, reflect the Board's assessment of the whole valley rather than a handful of fields.

The Gazette will continue to follow how growers in the valley respond to the findings.
